candidate_target_states.evidence: Continuous hourly ground-truth 10m wind speed measurements acquired from SMHI Abisko Aut station for full 2024 benchmark period.
Continuous hourly ground-truth 10m wind direction measurements acquired from SMHI Abisko Aut station for full 2024 benchmark period.
Abisko station (392m a.s.l.) requires boundary layer / altitude scaling (log-law or power-law) or spatial advection model to estimate Nuolja ridge top (702m a.s.l.) wind speed.
Zero direct turbine electrical generation measurements exist. Wind generation target requires an authorized IEC 61400-12-1 turbine power curve conversion model P = f(v).

data_sufficiency_assessment.explanation: Acquired SMHI Abisko Aut dataset provides empirical 1-hour wind speed and direction for full 2024 period, matching POLARIS 347 daily forecast origins and predictor tables. However, direct wind electrical generation (W) is not measured directly and requires a turbine power curve conversion model, and altitude scaling between Abisko (392m) and Nuolja (702m) must be formally specified.
conditionality_requirements: Authorization of an explicit IEC 61400-12-1 wind turbine power curve model (P = f(v)) to convert wind speed (m/s) to ForecastBundle.wind_generation (W).
Formal specification of altitude boundary layer scaling or direct use of Abisko station as the microgrid base station target.

a2_readiness_assessment.statement: A2 requires resolution of the documented data limitations (turbine power curve model authorization and altitude scaling verification) before authorization.
prerequisites_for_future_a2: Formal project governance authorization of wind turbine power curve conversion contract.
Pre-registration of canonical train/val/test fold splits for SMHI Abisko target.
Pre-registration of baseline models (Naive Persistence, Raw NWP) and evaluation metrics.
Explicit separate governance authorization issued for Phase A2.
